answer: The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. The anchor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
